claim_reviews.rationale: The four inputs, six ordered actions, explicit rejection, stopping condition and different next case are reusable instructions. The stop requires actual receiving operation and independent check, not approval or coincident labels.

The treaty Arts. 1 and 3 and Annex art. 7 (marked 1875 in consolidated text) create the institutional structure and mandate; catalogue screen found existing Metre Convention record but no modern kilogram definition or NIST-4 record.

1889 French proceedings pp. 38–40 record sanction and US assignment 4 and 20. Davis 1985 pp. 263–264 independently reports use of K20 as national and K4 as check, transcribes 1889 values and describes 1984 recalibration; certificate facsimiles were not inspected.

CGPM proceedings seventh session record unanimous vote 16 Nov 2018; resolution fixes h and specifies effective 20 May 2019. 2021 mise en pratique separately presents realization approaches; guide publication does not date a lab measurement.

CCM.M-K8.2019 §2 prescribes fixed h; §4.4 identifies NIST-4 and Sept–Oct 2019 series for K85/K104; Table 4 matches values and uncertainties. NIST operator participates in comparison report, not a wholly independent experiment.

Report §5 and Table 4 identify separate BIPM comparator values; reference mean includes NIST. 2024 comparison report §4.6 records 2025 NIST dates; it is repeated measurement with overlapping authors and apparatus, not independent NIST replication.

Haddad 2017 documents NIST-4 pre-vote h measurement; later fixed h is used to infer mass. NIST and BIPM date consensus dissemination to 1 February 2021; this is not equated with direct 2019 realization.
Added original treaty citation supports convention institution and mandate; original existing claims not reapproved wholesale.

French proceedings pp. 34–40 date sanction and allocation, including US 4,20. Shipment and later operation are correctly separated. Existing event dates treaty signing rather than representing 1889 sanction; this is an extension.
The institutional definition is a dated decision, not a specific measured instrument; proceedings resolution gives value, units and dependency on metre and second.
Vote 16 November 2018 and operative date 20 May 2019 are distinct in proceedings; old IPK definition abrogated when revision took effect.

Type builds_on means developed out of other. Existing capability endpoint is the institutional framework; treaty Art. 3 and Annex 7 establish CGPM and mandate, proceedings record its decision. Scoped institutional development is supported, not a claim the 1875 treaty fixed h. Treaty and proceedings are separate official primary documents, with shared institutional lineage.
A specific NIST direct post-revision realization, with Pt-Ir specimens 85 and 104, is separate from the definition and from instrument construction.
2019 §4.4 identifies NIST operator, vacuum, both series and date; 2024 report §4.6 identifies fresh 2025 runs on same masses. First event means earliest examined post-revision series, not invention.
Table 4 NMI realization columns give -0.7679 ±0.027 mg and +0.398 ±0.0273 mg offsets from 1 kg as standard uncertainties under specified conditions; comparator values are distinct.

Type requires means function without which recipient could not work. For the narrowly scoped post-2019 numerical mass assignment—not construction or operation of the balance—the specified fixed value h is essential under §2. Both endpoints and event direction checked. Normative resolution and multi-lab report independently document rule and actual operation, although NIST authors contribute to the latter; BIPM comparator supplies separate scrutiny, not an independent NIST run.
